title: Torso of a deity
description: One relief of Ravalnath in half relief. It is broken in four pieces. The head is mutilated. A  little evidence is left. Legs below the knee broken . It is in the very bad state of preservation.The image of Ravalnath was worshipped as a 'Bhkshatanamurthi' or 'Pari- varadevata' (family god) by the Hindu populations of Goa, particularly the cattle raising communities during ancient and medieval times.
